common.philosophy: Buy books · Discover knowledge · Read · Learn · Write · Share
common.notFoundText: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
common.errorText: We could not load this page. Please try again in a moment.
common.offlineText: Check your internet connection. Pages you opened earlier are still available.
common.allCaughtUpText: Time to read something? Your library is waiting.

landing.heroSubtitle: A calm place to buy books, discover knowledge and grow as a reader, writer and learner.
landing.studentZoneText: Study resources, subject books, quizzes and study groups — safely moderated.
landing.challengeText: Build a reading habit at your own pace. Earn badges for real reading, not for scrolling.
landing.clubsText: Read together with your school, college, university or friends.
landing.why1Text: Sellers and publishers are identity-verified. Used books show their real condition.
landing.why2Text: bKash, Nagad, Rocket, cards, internet banking or cash on delivery anywhere in Bangladesh.
landing.why3Text: Library, reading goals, clubs and challenges that respect your time.
landing.why4Text: Students, teachers and authors share knowledge in a safe community.
landing.ctaText: Create a free account to save books, join clubs and track your reading.
landing.sellCtaText: Reach readers across all 64 districts with verified seller tools.

messages.otpSms: {code} is your Boikonika code. It expires in {minutes} minutes. Never share it with anyone.
messages.otpEmailExpiry: It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this message — someone may have typed your address by mistake.
messages.accountExistsSms: Someone tried to create a Boikonika account with this number, but you already have one. Log in or reset your password at {url}.
messages.accountExistsEmailSubject: You already have a Boikonika account
messages.accountExistsEmailBody:
Someone (hopefully you) tried to create a new Boikonika account with this email address, but an account already exists.

Log in or reset your password at {url}. If this was not you, no action is needed.
messages.newSignInBody: Your account was signed in from {device} ({ip}) on {time}. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, change your password and sign out of other devices.
messages.passwordChangedBody: The password for your Boikonika account was changed on {time}. If you did not do this, reset your password now and contact support.
messages.twoFactorEnabledBody: Your account now asks for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in. Keep your recovery codes in a safe place.
messages.twoFactorDisabledBody: Two-step verification was turned off for your account on {time}. If you did not do this, reset your password now.

kyc.selfReview: You cannot review your own verification.
